product_metadata.title: RSVP International Cheese Slicer Cut Cheese, Meats & Other Appetizers, 10.25x9.5x1", Gray Marble
features: ELEGANT DESIGN: Made of beautiful natural marble with a stainless steel lever and wire cutter, each piece has a unique pattern and color
DIMENSIONS: The cheese slicer approximately measures 9x7,75x1" overall, comes with two replacement wires taped to bottom of cheese board
FUNCTIONAL: An elegant way to slice, cut, and serve a variety of different cheeses, perfect for entertaining
USER-FRIENDLY: Our clever design allows the wire to pass completely and efficiently through the cheese into the groove below ready for your party cheese plate
CARE INSTRUCTIONS: Handwashing is recommended for proper care
description: RSVP strives to offer quality kitchen products and cooking tools. When all the right people, ingredients, kitchen tools, and food come together, we call this The Art of Gathering. This beautiful marble cheese slicer has a stainless steel lever and wire cutter, making this an elegant way to slice, cut, and serve a variety of cheeses that is perfect for entertaining. Due to the natural marble material, there will be variations of pattern and color from what is shown on the box and images. The cheese slicer approximately measures 10.25x9.5x1" overall, and the marble slap measures 9x6". This comes with two replacement wires taped to the bottom of the cheese board. There are even protective rubber feet on the base to help keep it in place while in use. Please note that overtightening may cause the wire to break. Care Instructions: We recommend handwashing the item for proper care.
